Key features include a large, bright red serrated comb, prominent red wattles, a yellowish-grey beak, and vivid orange hackle feathers transitioning to darker plumage on the back. The background is a soft, out-of-focus beige/brown.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the texture of the comb. Real combs have a porous, slightly rough texture. AI often renders them too smooth or plastic-like. Also, verify if the hackle feathers have distinct shafts or if they merge into a solid mass of color.
